test: cucumber.transcript.ApiTranscriptsTest > Given transcript files left by an earlier run, when a recording run starts, then the folder is emptied, so no stale file survives
reason: #199 runs the Cucumber suites in two forks that write into one transcript folder at the same time, so a JVM emptying it at its start would delete what the other fork had written; the recording Gradle task acceptanceTest empties the folder before its forks start
replacement: acceptanceTest in backend/build.gradle.kts deletes build/api-transcripts before a recording run (API_TRANSCRIPTS=record); the PR's recording run removed a stale file planted there and wrote the same transcripts as regression/v2/api
contract: .claude/rules/testing.md, Regression against v2 (Recording) and docs/system-overview.md, Backend tests
